title: A library wall that made reading loud
summary: A 12-meter literary mural for a secondary school library, weaving Urdu and English literary quotes into a single flowing composition.
outcome: The library became the school's most photographed space — and its busiest.

title: The wall people cross the city to sit under
summary: A botanical multi-panel installation behind the bar of a specialty roastery, designed around the room's evening light.
outcome: The owner reports it appears in a majority of customer photos tagged at the café.

title: A lobby that finally matched the pitch deck
summary: Reception branding wall plus a nine-piece art program across two floors for a growing fintech, from floor plan to final level check.
outcome: Delivered over one weekend — zero disruption to the working week.
